Tes comètes rebondissent dans l’arène et: Your comets bounce around the arena and shatter crystals. Every crystal you break earns coins.
Quand tous les cristaux sont détruits, t: When every crystal is destroyed you go one depth deeper and a new grid appears. The deeper you go, the tougher the crystals.
Le jeu tourne tout seul : tu peux poser: The game plays itself: you can put the phone down, and you keep earning even when you leave the app.
Touche l’arène pour infliger des dégâts: Tap the arena to deal damage around your finger. The Impact upgrade enlarges the area.
Combo de touches : chaque touche enchaîn: Tap combo: every tap chained within three quarters of a second adds 2% damage, up to +100%. The ×N counter shows from ×5 and the sound rises in pitch.
Tes touches comptent aussi pour les cris: Your taps also count against golden crystals, meteors and golden comets.
Dans l’onglet Comètes, achète des comète: In the Comets tab, buy comets with your coins. Each purchase costs a little more than the last.
Trois comètes du même palier fusionnent: Three comets of the same tier merge into one comet of the next tier, faster and stronger. A merge triggers a shockwave and a “MERGE” text.
Tu peux aussi monter le niveau de chaque: You can also level up each tier to make it stronger.
Le bouton ×1 / ×10 / ×100 / ×MAX règle c: The ×1 / ×10 / ×100 / ×MAX button sets how many purchases you make at once. Your choice is remembered between sessions.
L’amélioration Auto-fusion fusionne les: The Auto-merge upgrade merges triplets for you.
Vitesse : comètes plus rapides. Puissanc: Speed: faster comets. Power: damage. Prospecting: earnings. Critical: chance of a ×4 hit. Splash: a shattered crystal deals part of its HP to its neighbours.
Capacité : nombre maximum de comètes. Pe: Capacity: maximum number of comets. Impact: tap area. Idle: offline earnings. Auto-merge: automatic merging.
Chaque niveau coûte plus cher. Ces améli: Each level costs more. These upgrades reset at every ascension.
Tous les 10 niveaux, un cristal géant ap: Every 10 depths a giant crystal appears, with an on-screen intro and a health bar at the bottom of the arena.
Il existe cinq types : le Colosse (solid: There are five kinds: the Colossus (sturdy), the Armored (break its armor first), the Regenerating (heals continuously), the Spectre (untouchable at times) and the Fractal (splits into three when it dies).
Le vaincre rapporte beaucoup de pièces,: Defeating it pays a lot of coins, gems ◆ and often a chest. If it holds out, boost your damage or fire a power.
Chaque cristal brisé d’affilée augmente: Every crystal broken in a row raises your earnings by 1.25%, up to 40 crystals, i.e. +50%. The streak drops if you wait too long.
Aux séries de 50 et 100, un court ralent: At streaks of 50 and 100, a short slow-motion marks the feat.
Les pouvoirs se débloquent avec des gemm: Powers unlock with gems ◆ once you reach the required depth: Nova (depth 20), Lightning (25), Magnet (35), Midas (45).
Nova : une onde frappe tous les cristaux: Nova: a shockwave hits every crystal. Lightning: bolts strike several crystals. Magnet: comets home in on crystals. Midas: coins ×3 for a short time.
Les boutons s’affichent dans l’arène une: The buttons show up in the arena once a power is unlocked. Each power has a cooldown that you can reduce by upgrading it.
Les gemmes ◆ s’obtiennent en battant des: Gems ◆ come from beating bosses, opening chests, earning achievements and challenges, and sometimes from breaking a crystal.
Trois boosts temporaires : Surcharge (ga: Three temporary boosts: Overcharge (earnings ×2), Turbo (comets ×1.6 faster) and Fury (damage ×3). The pills under the depth title activate them without opening the shop. Tap an already active pill twice to extend it.
La boutique propose aussi un coffre grat: The shop also offers a regular free chest and daily deals paid in gems.
Les coffres contiennent des pièces, parf: Chests hold coins, sometimes gems, a boost or a star. The rarer the chest, the more generous.
Ils tombent sur les boss, comme récompen: They drop from bosses, as mission and challenge rewards, and in the shop. Tap a chest to open it.
À partir de la profondeur 3, un événemen: From depth 3 on, an event pops up about every two minutes. One at a time.
Pluie de météorites : touche-les avant q: Meteor shower: tap them before they cross the arena; each one pays coins and a perfect catch gives a bonus.
Cristal doré : tape-le 8 fois en moins d: Golden crystal: tap it 8 times within 14 seconds for coins, gems and sometimes a rare chest.
Comète sauvage : attrape-la pour 15 s de: Wild comet: catch it for 15 s of Fury and 25 s of Turbo.
Les comètes dorées classiques existent t: The classic golden comets are still around: tap them for a coin bonus.
L’onglet Missions propose des objectifs: The Missions tab offers goals that renew themselves and a daily chest to claim.
Dans le Journal 🏆, l’onglet Défis contie: In the Journal 🏆, the Challenges tab has three challenges a day, a weekly challenge with three big goals (gems and chests), and your 30-day login calendar.
Se connecter chaque jour augmente les pi: Logging in every day raises the coins and gems of the daily chest. Special bonuses on days 7, 14, 21, 28 and 30.
Les succès se débloquent tout seuls et r: Achievements unlock by themselves and pay coins, sometimes gems. Some are hidden: it’s up to you to find them.
Le Codex se remplit en découvrant des cr: The Codex fills up as you discover crystals, bosses and events. Each entry gives +1% earnings.
À partir de la profondeur 20, tu peux as: From depth 20 you can ascend from the Vault tab: you start over (coins, comets, upgrades) but earn stars ★.
Chaque étoile augmente durablement tes g: Each star permanently raises your earnings and damage by 10%. The deeper your best depth, the more stars you earn.
Chaque ascension te donne aussi des poin: Every ascension also gives you talent points. From the 3rd one, you pick a relic.
Il y a 18 reliques. Chacune donne un gro: There are 18 relics. Each gives a big advantage but a small drawback: pick the one that fits your playstyle.
Tu en reçois une à choisir à chaque asce: You get one to choose at every ascension from the 3rd. They stack and are kept from one ascension to the next.
L’onglet Talents est un arbre à trois br: The Talents tab is a three-branch tree: Economy, Power and Automation, with 15 talents.
Touche un talent pour voir son effet, pu: Tap a talent to see its effect, then upgrade it with your points. A talent only unlocks once the one before it has been learned.
Les talents sont permanents. Tu peux tou: Talents are permanent. You can reset them all for free to get your points back.
Après 20 ascensions, tu peux transcender: After 20 ascensions you can transcend from the Vault: you lose your stars, ascensions and relics.
En échange, tu gagnes un multiplicateur: In return you gain a permanent +0.3 multiplier on earnings and damage with each transcendence, plus 25 ◆ and 5 talent points.
Le jeu travaille pendant ton absence: The game works while you’re away
Quand tu reviens, un écran « Bon retour: When you come back, a “Welcome back!” screen sums up what you earned. You earn half of your average pace, capped at 8 hours.
L’amélioration Veille, les talents Somme: The Idle upgrade, the Profitable sleep talent and some relics increase these earnings.
Journal → Style : choisis l’apparence de: Journal → Style: pick the look of your comets (some unlock with gems or achievements) and the interface theme: Auto, Glacier, Forge, Jade or Crystal rose.
Chaque zone de profondeur a aussi son dé: Each depth zone also has its own scenery and particles.
Dans ⚙ : son, vibrations, secousses, eff: In ⚙: sound, haptics, shake, light effects, floating numbers, number format, language, notifications and battery saver mode (30 fps, 15 when you stop touching the screen).
Ta partie est sauvegardée automatiquemen: Your game is saved automatically. You can export it as a code to move it to another device and restore it the same way.
Le bouton Mettre à jour récupère la dern: The Update button fetches the latest version of the game without losing your save.

Les améliorations durent toute la partie: Upgrades last the whole run: each level costs a bit more.
